summary: Leaving before the term ends: You will not serve out your term, and when and how you leave decides who comes next.
realLife: One life: A year after she was shot, she resigned in January 2012 to focus on recovery; a friend read her letter on the House floor, and her wounded staffer Ron Barber later won the seat. Another: After losing his 2014 primary he quit as majority leader, then resigned his seat early and took a job at an investment bank within weeks. Another: Confirmed as secretary of state 94 to 3 in 2013, he resigned from the Senate.
gates: A reason to leave is on record: your health, a lost primary, an appointment.
choices: resign on a date that helps whoever follows
resign in person on the floor
